sloka: प्रणम्य मूर्ध्ना पतिता वसुधायाम् समाहिताः ।सुग्रीवः प्रकृतीः सर्वाः संभाष्य उत्थाप्य वीर्यवान् ॥४-२६-२१॥
transliteration: praṇamya mūrdhnā patitā vasudhāyām samāhitāḥ ।sugrīvaḥ prakṛtīḥ sarvāḥ saṁbhāṣya utthāpya vīryavān ॥4-26-21॥

translations.english: Asking the monkeys to rise to their feet, the mighty and powerful Sugriva entered the inner chambers of his brother.
